Our total company emissions (market-based) in 2021
were approximately 14 million mtCO2. Of this total,
about 120,000 mtCO2 were Scope 1 emissions at
Microsoft datacenters and campuses. Taking into
account our renewable energy purchases, our Scope 2
emissions were approximately 160,000 mtCO2. The bulk
of our emissions—more than 97 percent—are in Scope 3,
which includes emissions from our supply chain, the
lifecycle of our hardware products and devices, travel,
and other indirect sources.
While our combined Scope 1 and 2 emissions
decreased this year, we did see an increase in Scope 3
emissions, driven mainly by the growth of our cloud
services business and an increase in sales and usage
of our devices.
